page.title: Jobs
page.purpose: Make long-running, server-owned work legible: what is queued, what is running, why something is waiting, and what profile rung it was admitted at.

priorities.statement: Waiting is explained. A queued job names what it is waiting for — a GPU lease, a model load, or another job.
A job that was admitted at a reduced rung says so on its result, so degraded output is never mistaken for full-quality output.
Closing the page does not affect the run; the work is server-owned.

claims.statement: A queued job displays what it is waiting for.
A job completed at a reduced rung is labelled with that rung.
A failed job surfaces a recovery classification rather than a bare error.
A running job exposes progress to assistive technology.
